auditExceptions.README: Load-bearing `overrides` notes and accepted `npm audit` findings. Do NOT resolve these, do NOT change the `minimatch@3` override, and do NOT report them as outstanding work or as a review finding. This field is documentation only; npm ignores it. The CI gate is `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`, which reports 0 — the production tree carries no accepted advisories. Never run `npm audit fix --force`: it proposes a Sanity 5.14.1 downgrade.

overrideNotes.vercel-frameworks: @vercel/frameworks exact-pins js-yaml@3.13.1 and smol-toml@1.5.2 in every published version, including the newest (3.24.0). js-yaml is forced to 3.14.2 — the backported patch on the 3.x line, which clears the js-yaml advisory while keeping the `safeLoad` API that @vercel/frameworks' dist/read-config-file.js calls. Do NOT 'upgrade' this to js-yaml 4.x: it removed safeLoad. smol-toml is forced to 1.6.1, which @sanity/cli already resolves elsewhere in the same tree, so it dedupes rather than adding a version.
